newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-INJURY FORCES PAULO FUTRE TO RETIRE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURY FORCES PAULO FUTRE TO RETIRE.

text.p: Former Portuguese international winger Paulo Futre announced on Tuesday that he was retiring from soccer at the age of 30 because of a recurring knee problem.
Futre, who was playing for London's West Ham, was capped 40 times by Portugal.
He began his career at Sporting before moving to Porto where he helped the club to the European Championship in 1987.
There followed stints with Spain's Atletico Madrid, Benfica, Marseille, Reggiana and AC Milan before moving to West Ham.
